headline: TAEYEON drops 'Unspecial' MV teaser ahead of Nov 30 return
sub: Her first full-length album in nearly five years

points.title: What to know
items: Title track shares the album's name
Solo concert 'F.L.Y.' at KSPO DOME Jan 15-17

source: Source: SMTOWN official YouTube, via Korean media
caption:
TAEYEON has released the music video teaser for 'Unspecial', the title track of her 4th studio album.

The 12-track album drops Nov 30 at 6 PM KST — her first full-length release since 'INVU' in February 2022. Next up: her solo concert 'F.L.Y.' at KSPO DOME in Seoul, Jan 15-17.

📌 Source: SMTOWN official YouTube, via Korean media (Specialtimes, Korea Times)
